source.note: The flight leaves TRUKN2 at its base fix, so the route is spoken "then as filed". TRUKN2 publishes FL190 and the filed 11,000 is below it, so FAA JO 7110.65 4-3-2 c 4 makes this "climb via SID except maintain 11,000" rather than a plain climb via SID (user decision 2026-09-15). The aircraft is then assigned the altitude it filed, so `phraseology.expectAltitude: only_when_interim_below_filed` drops the expect clause.
